name: Calm Sentences
description: Eight slow, soft sentences to type with no clock to beat.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight slow, calm sentences to type, shown on Typing Drills.
help.goal: Nothing to beat. Type gently and stop whenever you like.
howToPlay: Correct characters are underlined and mistakes are struck through.
At the end of a sentence the next one appears.
tips: Your place is saved. What you type never leaves this page.
